verdict.rationale: The evidence shows event plumbing: a webhooks list endpoint and event subscriptions via websocket. These are developer building blocks that a programmer could use to build automation, not a product-native way to define rules that trigger actions on events. Nothing in the pack documents a rule engine, workflow builder, or event-to-action automation inside Dialpad itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
